source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Using the selected layout, players agree which battlefield edges match the Attacker's and Defender's edges on the card. Then roll off; the winner picks who is Attacker and who is Defender.

detail.agree: which physical table edges match the edges the card marks for Attacker and Defender
detail.assignment: winner decides who is Attacker and who is Defender
